cohort: Term and late preterm neonates with perinatal asphyxia (defined as cord blood pH ≤ 6.99 and/or base deficit ≥ 16 mmol/L).
finding: Thrombocytopenia occurred in 31% of asphyxiated neonates compared to 5% of non-asphyxiated controls, platelet counts nadired on day 3 and normalized by days 19-21, and were inversely correlated with nucleated red blood cell counts.
